title: Energia Global International historical Bermuda registration jurisdiction
summary: ICIJ records Energia Global International, Ltd. as registered in Bermuda from its 1997 incorporation until its 2012 closure. IFC independently described the company as incorporated in Bermuda. Neither reviewed source establishes a street headquarters or registered-office address.
